 NPL-3: Sudurpaschim secures comfortable win against Janakpur
 November 10, 2026 
 Kathmandu: In the ongoing third edition of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) T20 cricket tournament, Sudurpaschim Royals secured a comfortable victory against Janakpur Bolts by 27 runs.
 Photo Courtesy: Sudurpaschim Royals/Facebook 
 It is the fourth win for Sudurpaschim Royals in the ongoing tournament, while Janakpur Bolts suffered a defeat for the third consecutive match. Chasing a target of 121 runs set by Sudurpaschim Royals, Janakpur Bolts were bowled out for 93 runs in 19.5 overs. 
 For Janakpur Bolts, Tritraj Das scored 21 runs, while James Neesham scored 20, Rahul Yadav 11, and Aditya Mahat 10. None of the other batters was able to reach double digits. 
 For Sudurpaschim, Scott Kuggeleijn took 3 wickets, while captain Dipendra Singh Airee, Ishan Pandey, Anil Kharel, Hemant Dhami, and Tharindu Ratnayake claimed one wicket each.
